principle: Combinations are contextual relationships, not fixed pair definitions. Position and question outrank pair lore.

relationship_types.reinforce: Both cards independently support the same central theme.
relationship_types.qualify: The second card narrows, conditions, or complicates the first.
relationship_types.contrast: The cards pull in meaningfully different directions.
relationship_types.sequence: The cards form a plausible developmental or cause-to-effect movement.
relationship_types.redirect: A later card changes the trajectory implied by an earlier one.
